scenes.title: キャンパス到着と手続き
scenes.story: Welcome to the bustling university campus! After securing their official admission, new students must first focus on paying their tuition at the finance desk. Nearby, other students complete their course registration by clicking through screens on their laptops. Across the hall, a crowd gathers to check the huge bulletin board for housing options. Some students choose to live in the traditional on-campus dormitory, while others prefer to pay rent for private apartments in town. In the centre of the lobby, a lost freshman looks completely confused while holding a campus map, but a helpful sophomore kindly points the way to the library. On the wall, large academic calendars explain the academic year: one chart shows a year divided into four sections for a quarter system, while another chart displays just two halves for a standard semester.

scenes.title: 大講堂の授業
scenes.story: The grand lecture hall is packed with every undergraduate taking the foundational science course. The professor begins the morning by checking attendance, carefully counting the raised hands across the room. She holds up the syllabus, a thick booklet outlining the entire term. She clearly explains that this foundational class is a strict prerequisite for advanced studies, unlike an elective which students choose purely for personal interest or fun. She then passes down a printed handout to the front row to share with the class. This demanding course requires a weekly assignment, usually a short essay written at home. Furthermore, every Friday there is a quick quiz to test basic memory, leading up to the massive, stressful final exam at the end of the year. Unlike normal graded courses, this module is strictly pass-fail, meaning you either succeed entirely or you do not.

scenes.title: 成績評価と卒業
scenes.story: Halfway through the academic year, anxious students must face their difficult midterm tests. One unfortunate student receives a terrible grade on his paper, realizing he might completely flunk the course. As a result, he is placed on strict academic probation, forced to study inside a restricted desk area under close supervision to improve his habits. Eventually, all final marks are permanently recorded on a long, official transcript. At the end of the long educational journey, a successful bachelor joins the grand commencement ceremony. On the beautifully decorated stage, he proudly receives his official folded diploma. Alongside him, short-term students are awarded a smaller framed certificate for their brief courses. Many years later, these proud graduates will return to the exact same campus for a joyful reunion to celebrate their shared memories and toast to their youth.

scenes.title: 農家の1年
scenes.story: On Hill Farm, the year begins in early spring. Tom hitches his old horse to the plow and turns over the heavy soil in the long field. A week later, his daughter Amy walks along the furrows and sows the seeds by hand. Soon, rows of tiny green seedlings push up through the earth. The summer is dry, so Tom opens the narrow irrigation channel, and cool water runs between the rows. By July, the wheat stands tall and golden, and beside it the barley bends in the wind, its long whiskers shining in the sun. When the grain is ripe, the whole family comes out to reap it with sickles. Across the lane, apples hang heavy in the orchard, and grapes darken on the vines of the little vineyard. The cows spend their days grazing in the meadow. In autumn, grass from the meadow is cut, dried and stored as hay in the big red barn, to feed the animals through the winter. The leftover stalks of the wheat are tied into bales of straw, which make warm beds for the cows.

scenes.title: 荒れ狂う山の天気
scenes.story: A hiker experiences every extreme of nature on a mountain pass. In the valley below, a thick fog hides the ground completely, while a thin mist floats above a nearby lake. Further away, a brownish haze obscures the distant city. Fine drizzle falls on the hiker's jacket, but the nearby leaves are covered in white frost. From the cabin roof, a sharp icicle hangs, though a sudden thaw makes it drip. High above, a small plane shakes violently in the turbulence. Dark storm clouds gather, and a flash of lightning strikes the peak. In the distance, a massive tornado spins across the plains, often called a twister by the locals. Suddenly, a blinding blizzard sweeps in, triggering a huge avalanche of snow that crashes down the mountain slope.

scenes.story: The local environment is suffering from a series of terrible disasters. On the right side of the valley, a severe drought has baked the land for months, leaving behind a cracked, barren wasteland where absolutely nothing grows. On the left side, heavy torrential rains have caused a massive flood. The rising waters relentlessly inundate the nearby houses, filling them to the roof. In the background, a giant billboard showing a glass dome over the Earth perfectly illustrates the greenhouse effect. Nearby, a hillside shows the ugly, tragic scars of deforestation, with only dead tree stumps remaining. Below the hill, an industrial factory releases thick black smoke, causing severe air pollution, while its bright green toxic waste leaks into the river to completely contaminate the town's water supply.

scenes.title: 大評議会と異端審問
scenes.story: In the Great Hall, the high council debates the strict laws of the faith. On the central pedestal rests the official doctrine, a massive, heavy book of rules with a brass lock. Nailed firmly to the stone wall is the dogma, an iron plaque of unquestionable laws. The roof itself is supported by four massive pillars, each carved with a core tenet of their belief. A group of followers marches in carrying a bright banner displaying their shared creed. Among them, one man clutches a small personal medallion to his chest, whispering his own credo. Suddenly, a wild-eyed fanatic bursts into the hall, smashing a wooden chair in a rage. Outside the window, a martyr is tied to a stake, smiling peacefully despite the flames at his feet. Nearby, a scholar is arrested for heresy because he holds a forbidden text with a green eye symbol. In the dark woods beyond, a witch stirs a bubbling purple cauldron, while a goat is led to a stone altar for a dark sacrifice.

scenes.title: 知恵の広場
scenes.story: In the bustling secular marketplace, far from any temples, merchants trade everyday goods. A travelling missionary stands by the fountain, handing out translated books to curious foreigners. Under a large oak tree, a wise teacher seeks to enlighten his followers, pointing to a bright sunburst diagram on a board. A young disciple sits at his feet, taking careful notes on a slate. Nearby, a wealthy merchant practises philanthropy by dropping gold coins into a beggar's bowl. On a stone bench, two scholars engage in a deep dialogue, their speech bubbles filled with interlocking gears. One holds a human skull, lost in thoughts of philosophy. The other points from a large triangle down to a single dot on a chalkboard, demonstrating logical deduction. In the eastern corner, a scholar in flowing silk robes holds a rolled bamboo slip, teaching the ways of Confucianism. Finally, a judge holds a brass scale weighing a heart against a gold bar, symbolising the strict ethics that govern the society.

scenes.title: 脳と心のクリニック
scenes.deckLabel: 13 人体・医学・臓器・専門語
scenes.story: In the psychiatry department, a doctor treats a patient lying on a comfortable couch. He uses traditional psychoanalysis to explore her childhood memories, and occasionally employs hypnosis by swinging a shiny pocket watch to relax her. On the doctor's desk rests a large, cross-sectional model of the human brain. The massive top part, the cerebrum, features a deeply wrinkled outer layer called the cortex. At the lower back sits the smaller cerebellum. Deep inside the centre, you can see the egg-shaped thalamus, the tiny hypothalamus just below it, and the curved, seahorse-like hippocampus. On a computer monitor, an educational video displays a branching neuron and a flashing synapse where chemical signals cross the gap.

scenes.title: 木工所の事故
scenes.deckLabel: 13 人体・医学・臓器・専門語
scenes.story: In the woodshop, a careless carpenter suffered a terrible accident that could permanently maim him. A sharp saw slipped and left a deep, jagged gash on his forearm. At first, there was a severe hemorrhage as bright red blood poured out, but soon a thick, dark clot began to form and stop the bleeding. Shocked, he held up his uninjured hand, counting his digits to calm his nerves: the thick thumb, the pointing index finger, the long middle finger, the ring finger, and the tiny pinkie. Looking down, he realised he had also dropped a heavy wooden block on his foot, bruising his big toe right through his leather boot.

scenes.title: 内臓の展示
scenes.deckLabel: 13 人体・医学・臓器・専門語
scenes.story: The science museum features a beautifully detailed, life-sized, transparent model of the human abdomen. Inside the lower half of the body, you can clearly see the large, reddish-brown liver and a pair of bean-shaped organs, with one kidney visible at the back. Below the stomach lies the long, winding gut. This complex digestive tract is divided into the narrow, tightly coiled small intestine and the wider, bumpy large bowel, which processes solid waste before we eventually defecate. The model also highlights the urinary system: a yellow, balloon-like sac called the bladder stores liquid urine. Just below the bladder sits the small, walnut-shaped prostate gland, which is an important part of the male reproductive system.

scenes.title: 救急室の危機
scenes.deckLabel: 13 人体・医学・臓器・専門語
scenes.story: The emergency room is extremely chaotic tonight. In the waiting area, a patient who took a severe blow to the head suffers from a dizzying concussion, while a woman beside him clutches her forehead, blinded by a terrible migraine. Suddenly, a man on the floor experiences a terrifying brain seizure. His hand locks into a tight muscle spasm, which is immediately followed by a violent, full-body convulsion. Meanwhile, in the trauma bay, doctors rush to resuscitate a critical patient who has slipped into a deep, unresponsive coma. Finally, the monitor shows his heart begin to throb steadily again, pumping fresh oxygenated blood through the thick red artery and returning it via the thin blue vein.

scenes.title: 感染症の研究所
scenes.deckLabel: 13 人体・医学・臓器・専門語
scenes.story: In the hospital's pathology department, a professor uses a microscope to study how diseases change human tissue. He points to a row of preserved specimens in glass jars: a blackened lung ruined by tuberculosis, another lung filled with heavy fluid from severe pneumonia, and a stomach wall damaged by a deep, bleeding ulcer. He also displays an x-ray of swollen, crooked joints caused by painful arthritis, and a slide of abnormal blood from a patient battling leukemia. On the wall, a historical poster explains how mild cowpox from dairy cattle was used to create the first vaccine against deadly smallpox. Below it, a rusty nail is displayed as a warning about the dangerous bacteria that cause tetanus.

scenes.title: 外科と代替医療のクリニック
scenes.deckLabel: 13 人体・医学・臓器・専門語
scenes.story: The new medical centre offers a remarkably wide range of treatments. In the bright surgical theatre, a patient breathes gas for deep anesthesia while the surgeon makes a precise incision on his abdomen with a sharp scalpel. A secure locked cabinet nearby stores strong, pain-relieving narcotic pills and a rare vial of snake venom used for experimental research. In the next room, a practitioner performs traditional acupuncture, gently inserting fine needles into a client's back. However, the clinic faces some unusual challenges: a patient with severe claustrophobia is panicking, absolutely refusing to enter the narrow MRI tube. Furthermore, a stern poster warns doctors against legal malpractice, and a controversial brochure in the lobby discusses the ethics of euthanasia for the terminally ill.
